# Aerumna
A biological experiment gone wrong. A miserable failure by every sense of the word.
The entire surface of the planet is covered in Chimera biomass that no amount of immolation can fully remove. There is simply too much. Seas of Letoferol line the surface, rivers running through the biomass as it uses the fluid like a bloodstream to hold nutrients.
Almost no resources remain on this planet, the vast majority of surface ones being extracted by the biomass. No life except for the Chimera survives either due to the hazardous atmosphere from years of bio-terraforming.
[color=red]Some factions would pay lavishly if you were to be able to destroy this hazard somehow, or at least purge it of its plauge.[/color]
